name: Cambria–San Simeon

map.locality_method: Discovery extents route published regional data and prioritize nearby notices. They are not legal boundaries or evidence of fish presence. Protected areas use the authoritative polygon screen. Closed seasons remain selectable for future planning.

unavailable_targets.lobster: Spiny lobster is not in this region’s researched target list. This is target coverage, not a legal prohibition.

harbor.name: Morro Bay
harbor.entrance_note: Recheck the actual entrance at departure and return.

stations.tide_note: San Simeon is a NOAA subordinate tide-prediction station using Port San Luis offsets. Predicted highs and lows are not local currents, bottom drift or Morro Bay entrance clearance.

bathymetry.reason: USGS smoothed 10 m contours do not support native-depth target qualification or individual-rock imagery.

substrate.reason: USGS geological interpretation provides regional context, not a 2 m seabed classification.

groundtruth.reason: Promising primary sources identified; regional records, precision and rights still need review.

kelp.reason: Promising primary sources identified; regional records, precision and rights still need review.

protected-areas.reason: Regional DS582 snapshot plus complete live query; exports screen full geometries.

regulations.reason: Reviewed Central Management Area profiles; freshness and changes independently gate season status.

dynamic-closures.reason: Whale-risk, health, in-season and Diablo security sources are checked separately.

wind-forecast.reason: NOAA GFS and ECMWF IFS at regional sea-grid samples.

wave-forecast.reason: NOAA GFS Wave and ECMWF WAM at regional sea-grid samples.

wave-observations.reason: Diablo Canyon and offshore 46028 are reference buoys, not San Simeon observations.

weather-observations.reason: Source discovery and regional evidence gaps remain visible; this is not a complete measurement of the region.

tides.reason: NOAA San Simeon subordinate station 9412553 returned high/low predictions derived from Port San Luis offsets. These are not San Simeon current or bottom-drift predictions.

surface-currents.reason: Operational HFR observations and WCOFS surface forecasts; local reception holes remain blank and horizon is at most 72 hours.

subsurface-ocean.reason: Promising primary sources identified; regional records, precision and rights still need review.

sea-temperature.reason: Native 0.01-degree MUR analysis with dated source errors and masks; NOAA 0.04-degree WCOFS surface-temperature forecasts at actual populated times through at most 72 hours. Neither establishes fish-depth temperature or catch probability.

chlorophyll.reason: Source discovery and regional evidence gaps remain visible; this is not a complete measurement of the region.

species-occurrence.reason: Promising primary sources identified; regional records, precision and rights still need review.

catch-effort.reason: No local catch publisher is bound; Morro Bay landings cannot be assigned to these waters.

charter-identity.reason: No locally verified charter identity register is bound to this expansion.

ais-history.reason: No geographically reviewed charter AIS extraction is published for this expansion.

harbor-access.reason: Official notices are context, not automated departure or return entrance clearance.

wind-ensemble.reason: Reviewed live adapter with source/member metadata and grid distances; per-run availability is checked separately.

wave-ensemble.reason: Reviewed live adapter with source/member metadata and grid distances; per-run availability is checked separately.

forecast-verification.reason: Prospective forecast archive collecting observations; reports remain early samples until 30 matches across 7 days.

coverage_note: Expansion preview through San Simeon: reviewed geological context and regional conditions. Native-depth-qualified targets remain withheld until appropriate survey coverage and rights are resolved.
landing_note: Morro Bay totals do not locate catches in Cambria–San Simeon; no local report publisher is bound.
